definition: Real spatial, stratigraphic, fracture-network, or material variability in aquifer properties.
pumping_test_context: True variation in transmissivity and storage across wells, hydrogeologic units, and support scales.
metric_or_evidence: Log-variance and COV of fitted T and S, trend-adjusted variance, site geology.
limitation: No independent dense reference field is available, so inherent variability is not isolated directly.

definition: Error introduced by sensors, pumping-rate records, timing, baseline correction, and distance/support measurements.
pumping_test_context: Water-level noise, rate uncertainty, environmental correction, detection threshold, and well-location uncertainty.
metric_or_evidence: Residual floor, Lovelock weights and detection threshold, acknowledged error source.
limitation: Independent measurement-error budgets are unavailable for the primary case.

definition: Scatter introduced when indirect field responses are converted into derived parameters.
pumping_test_context: Drawdown responses are transformed into T and S through interpretation models.
metric_or_evidence: Log response model factor eta, SD eta, model-factor COV equivalent, residual distributions.
limitation: Reported as response-level transformation scatter rather than a complete variance decomposition.

definition: Uncertainty caused by simplified governing assumptions, boundary conditions, memory terms, and omitted processes.
pumping_test_context: Theis confined, Hantush-Jacob leaky, lagging Darcy no-leakage, and lagging Darcy with leakage define the primary competing field pathways.
metric_or_evidence: AIC, BIC, residual structure, validation performance, model-family positioning.
limitation: Constant-head boundary remains a sensitivity diagnostic outside the four primary pathways.

definition: Uncertainty from finite data, sparse wells, parameter tradeoff, and extrapolation.
pumping_test_context: Twelve primary wells and seven Lovelock wells constrain fitted parameters and validation.
metric_or_evidence: Local MAP correlations, boundary-hit counts, well-block validation, sample counts.
limitation: Local covariance is a quadratic approximation rather than full posterior inference.

definition: Uncertainty caused by comparing observations and parameters that integrate over different spatial or temporal supports.
pumping_test_context: Observation wells, pumping intervals, fractures, basin-fill units, and recovery data sample different support volumes.
metric_or_evidence: Distance-dependent diagnostics, trend adjustment, separate Lovelock external case.
limitation: Support volume is not measured independently for every observation pathway.

definition: Effect of the uncertainty budget on engineering margins, exceedance probabilities, or reliability decisions.
pumping_test_context: Different transformations change drawdown prediction, safety margins, and groundwater-control screening.
metric_or_evidence: Diagnostic drawdown exceedance probability and model-factor interval width.
limitation: Decision thresholds are diagnostic unless a project-specific design criterion is supplied.
